title: A simple, high-order and compact WENO limiter based on control volume for spectral volume method
summary: The spectral volume(SV) method constructs a high-order polynomial for SV based on the average value of control volume(CV), but for discontinuous problems, a limiter is required to mitigate oscillations. This paper presents a novel CV-based high-resolution limiter to effectively suppress oscillations and maintain CV resolution.
